title: Forecast-driven RL decision-making
description: Forecasting papers stop at prediction accuracy, while RL papers assume the state is fully observed. Few works feed learned forecasts directly into an RL policy.
evidence: Paper 04 (Informer): strong forecaster, no downstream decision layer
Paper 05 (DQN): strong policy learner, no forecast input
opportunity: Combine an attention-based forecaster (Paper 04) with an RL agent (Paper 05) in one closed loop.
searchGuidance: model-based RL with learned forecasts, predict-then-optimize
